title: Why Can't we Remake the Rocketdyne F1 Engine?
summary: Short Curious Droid video on why NASA could not simply rebuild the Saturn V's Rocketdyne F-1 engine for the SLS boosters. It explains that the engines were hand-tailored and that much of the know-how was never documented, so the blueprints were not enough.
why: Cited as the standard illustration of lost tacit knowledge and why old blueprints cannot be turned back into hardware.

quote.text: TLDR: everything was handcrafted, notes were not made or lost
